instruction: A narrow brick townhouse facade: a tall flat brick wall with a recessed doorway and door, two or three windows with protruding sills, string-course brick banding, and a flat roof parapet cap at the top. Red-brick texture via color.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a brick townhouse facade. A narrow brick townhouse facade: a tall flat brick wall with a recessed doorway and door, two or three windows with protruding sills, string-course brick banding, and a flat roof parapet cap at the top. Red-brick texture via color. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
